prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent game sprite sheet, 3 columns x 2 rows of SIX full-body standing curiosity poses of this exact mushroom-capped little girl. Input image 1 is approved three-quarter standing identity, image 2 approved frontal identity. Preserve face identity, big brown eyes, brown bob hair, red mushroom cap with ivory dots, olive leaf cape, red berry clasp, ivory petal dress and brown boots, same painterly 3D children's-book finish. She is attracted by an invisible firefly and her gaze/body actively follows it. NO firefly or orb painted into this sheet. Every cell same physical scale, same head-to-body ratio, complete boots and hat, common boot baseline. Frame 1 top left: standing facing LEFT in natural three-quarter, CHIN LIFTED, pupils looking clearly HIGH UP LEFT, delighted curious smile, one hand slightly lifted towards what she sees; frame 2 top middle: facing LEFT three-quarter, eyes looking horizontally LEFT, gentle forward lean and one open hand reaching out at waist height; frame 3 top right: facing LEFT three-quarter, chin tipped DOWN and both eyes looking down-left, a very slight curious bend at knees/waist and open relaxed hands; frame 4 bottom left: body and face nearly FRONTAL, head tilted UP, pupils directed upper LEFT, one hand softly raised near chest; frame 5 bottom middle: body and face nearly FRONTAL, head tilted UP, pupils directed upper RIGHT, mirrored soft curious hand gesture; frame 6 bottom right: FRONTAL, chin raised to watch something directly above, pupils looking UP, slightly amazed smile and both hands open lightly at chest height. Expressions engaged and natural, NEVER a blank straight-ahead stare. Strongly distinguish each intended eye direction; both eyes always visible, no strict profile. Preserve girl identity across all six, no oversized extra head, no independent head cutouts. Truly transparent background with clean soft alpha. NO ground, shadows, environment, props, text, labels, dividers, orb, watermark or duplicates. Each cell only ONE complete character, ample clear margins around hat/boots/hands.

Preserve the SIX distinct gaze directions/gestures of image 2 and its 3-column 2-row arrangement, but FIX its body proportions: it accidentally has a tall/slender body and small head. The approved character is very chibi with a HUGE red mushroom cap and LARGE round face, VERY SHORT ivory dress torso, stubby short legs and tiny boots. Match image 1 exactly: head+cap occupy approximately TWO THIRDS of total character height, shoulder/neck near 68 percent down, eyes about halfway down the full figure, bottom of dress near 86 percent, boot soles at 95 percent. This is essential; do not keep the elongated body of image 2. Same exact brown eyes/bob hair, olive leaf cape/red berry clasp, big red cap with cream dots, ivory petal dress and brown boots as image 1. All complete standing figures have same scale and sole baseline, and consistent big head size. Six poses, row order: 1 LEFT three-quarter chin raised and pupils UP-LEFT, curious reaching hand; 2 LEFT three-quarter eyes LEFT at same level with forward open hand; 3 LEFT three-quarter chin lowered and pupils DOWN-LEFT, gentle curious forward bend; 4 near-FRONTAL pupils UP-LEFT, one hand near chest; 5 near-FRONTAL pupils UP-RIGHT, one hand near chest; 6 FRONTAL chin/pupils UP toward something overhead, hands softly open. Both eyes visible. Keep warm delighted inquisitive expressions rather than blank staring. Painterly 3D storybook rendering matching image 1. NO orb, no background, no floor, no shadows, no labels or text. Genuine transparent alpha, full uncut hats/hands/boots within each cell. Do not crop or detach heads or assemble body parts, draw each pose as a whole character. The large-head/short-body proportions MUST be consistent with image 1, with no adult/long-legged proportions.
